notes: DisplayPort characterization centers on the Main Link PHY (eye, jitter, swing/pre-emphasis, inter-lane skew per rate), the AUX channel (Manchester-II timing), EDID/DPCD access, and FEC/error counters. Conformance is established by the VESA DisplayPort Compliance Test Specification (CTS); per-implementation PHY calibration is done at bring-up via the DPCD TEST_* automation registers.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Main Link eye diagram per rate
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the differential NRZ eye meets the budget at RBR/HBR/HBR2/HBR3 (8b/10b) and UHBR (128b/132b).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Voltage swing / pre-emphasis
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the 4 swing and 4 pre-emphasis levels and their bounded combinations.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Clock recovery / jitter
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the Sink CDR locks (CR_DONE) and meets jitter tolerance at each rate.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: AUX channel timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Validate Manchester-II ~1 Mbps request/reply timing and half-duplex turnaround.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: EDID read
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm I2C-over-AUX EDID retrieval (I2C address A0h).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: FEC / symbol-error rate
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm FEC correction and symbol/FEC-error counters when DSC/UHBR is active.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Compliance (CTS)
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Run the VESA DisplayPort Compliance Test Specification link/PHY/AUX/protocol suite.
